footer.transfers: Airport pickup & drop-off included with every journey.

hero.title: The Caucasus, *unhurried* & yours alone.
hero.subhead: Hand-crafted private journeys through Georgia's mountains, wine country and ancient cities — with a dedicated guide and airport transfers included, from the moment you land.

oneDay.title: One-day *tours*
oneDay.description: Set out after breakfast, return by evening. Each private day trip is fully guided, at your own pace — choose a base and we'll do the rest.

multiDay.title: Multi-day *packages*
multiDay.description: Longer, seamless itineraries that string the best of Georgia together — accommodation, guiding and every airport transfer handled end to end.

moments.title: Memories from *the road*
moments.description: Real photos and clips shared by guests across Georgia — from Kazbegi sunrises to Kakheti cellars. A glimpse of the trip waiting for you.

fleet.title: Premium cars, *every journey*
fleet.description: Modern, air-conditioned vehicles driven by our own guides — comfortable however far the road goes.

why.title: Premium, personal, *and effortless*
why.description: From your arrival gate to your final farewell, everything is handled with care. This is travel the way it should feel — private, considered and calm.

items.title: Private expert guides
items.description: Never a coach full of strangers. Every trip is just your party and a passionate local guide who tailors the day to you.

items.title: Airport transfers included
items.description: We meet you the moment you land and see you off at departure — every tour includes airport pickup and drop-off.

items.title: 500+ five-star reviews
items.description: A decade of guiding, thousands of happy travelers, and a near-perfect rating across TripAdvisor and Google.

items.title: Journeys built around you
items.description: Flexible pacing, hidden stops and honest recommendations — itineraries shaped by what you actually want to see.

reviews.title: Loved by travelers *worldwide*
reviews.certified: Only certified, genuinely written reviews from real guests — nothing is edited or invented.

cta.title: Your Georgia, *designed around you*.
cta.text: Tell us your dates and what you dream of seeing. We'll craft a private itinerary — airport transfers included — and have you exploring within days.

tourDetail.overviewBody: Every departure is fully private — just your party, a dedicated guide and a comfortable vehicle. We handle the details so you can be fully present: pacing to your energy, stopping where the light is good, and always leaving room for the unplanned discoveries that make a trip memorable.
tourDetail.askMessage: Hi WanderKartli, I'm interested in the "{tour}" tour.
tourDetail.reassurance: No payment today — reserve your dates and we'll confirm within 24 hours.

picker.title: Choose a tour to book
picker.text: Select the experience you'd like to reserve and we'll walk you through the details.

travelersStep.title: Your group & vehicle
travelersStep.description: Your tour is entirely private — pick your group size and the vehicle you'd like, and the price updates instantly.
travelersStep.travelersHint: Infants and children count toward the group — mention ages later.

vehicle.subFixed: This package is offered with a 4x4 Jeep.
vehicle.subSingle: One private vehicle for your group
vehicle.tooManyText: For larger groups we arrange extra vehicles or a coach. Message us and we'll tailor it to your party.
vehicle.whatsappMessage: Hi WanderKartli, we're a group of {pax} for the "{tour}" tour.

datesStep.title: When are you in Georgia?
datesStep.description: Because every tour includes airport pickup and drop-off, we need your arrival and departure dates to arrange your transfers.
datesStep.flightHint: Share your flight numbers and times so we can be at the gate.
datesStep.note: A driver will meet you in the arrivals hall with a name sign, included in your price.

detailsStep.title: Your details
detailsStep.description: Just so we can confirm your booking and reach you before the trip.

reviewStep.title: Review your booking
reviewStep.description: Please check the details below. You won't be charged yet — the next step is payment.
reviewStep.name: Name
reviewStep.note: Airport pickup on arrival and drop-off on departure are included.

paymentStep.confirmDescription: Send us your trip details and we'll reply within 24 hours to confirm everything. No payment is required now.
paymentStep.fine: We only use your details to arrange this tour. Questions? Call {phone}.
paymentStep.successTitle: Thank you — your request is on its way.
paymentStep.successText: We've emailed you a confirmation and our team will get back to you within 24 hours to finalise your private tour. No payment is taken now — you'll arrange it directly with us.

summary.fine: Private tour · all prices in USD

errors.travelersMax: For groups larger than {max}, please contact us directly.
errors.vehicleFit: Please choose a vehicle that fits your group.
errors.departureOrder: Departure must be on or after arrival.
errors.submitFailed: We couldn't send your request just now. Please try again, or reach us on WhatsApp.
